name: Four Seasons Hotel Baltimore
positioning: Modern urban hotel on the edge of Baltimore's Harbor East, with a spa, a rooftop infinity-edge pool and a 29th-floor rooftop bar
best_for: Guests who want a hotel spa with a private VIP Suite for couples
Travelers bringing a dog or cat up to 60 pounds

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Baltimore has 256 guest rooms and suites.
The hotel's address is 200 International Drive, Baltimore, Maryland 21202.
The hotel is on the edge of Baltimore's Harbor East.
Four Seasons describes the hotel as a modern urban retreat.
The Bygone is located atop the hotel on the 29th floor.
Maximón serves contemporary South American and Mexican cuisine.
The Spa is 10,000 square feet overlooking the harbor.
The Spa has 11 private treatment rooms.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The Fitness Centre was designed by Harley Pasternak.
Four Seasons lists the city's largest hotel art collection among the hotel's amenities.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop infinity-edge pool with panoramic views of the Inner Harbor.
Use of a relaxation room, a Finnish sauna, an aromatherapy steam room and heated hydrotherapy pool are complimentary with each spa treatment.
The Spa's private VIP Suite allows complete privacy to enjoy a couples' massage.
Winter Village offers a rotating prix fixe menu inside a private cottage overlooking Baltimore's Inner Harbor on the fourth-floor rooftop.
The hotel accommodates dogs and cats up to 60 pounds.

considerations.text: The Spa page lists the outdoor pool as closed for the season.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the rooms as plush-but-generic.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
